newsitem.title: USA: Ekco to take Q3, Q4 charges, suspend payout.
newsitem.headline: Ekco to take Q3, Q4 charges, suspend payout.

text.p: Ekco Group Inc said Wednesday it will record a non-cash charge of about $22.3 million in the third quarter related to the reduction of goodwill and the carrying value of its plastics business and a $6.5 million charge in the fourth quarter related to the consolidatiion ot its cleaning products manufacturing activities at a facility in Obregon, Mexico.
Ekco also said that its board of directors suspended the payment of a quarterly dividend and does not anticipate paying cash dividends for the foreseeable future.
